title: poikilospermum suaveolens
intro: Poikilospermum suaveolens, commonly known as "Tangle Vine", is a plant species in the family Melastomataceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Poikilospermum suaveolens include antioxidant and antitumor activities, potentially providing protection against oxidative stress and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
